editorial.blurb: Cafe Zamora is a beloved Avondale institution serving masterful Mexican comfort food that keeps locals and visitors coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for spicy salsa with your complimentary chips if you like heat—the default has a milder, balanced flavor. The chimichanga is their calling card and worth ordering.

topDishes.note: Perfectly golden-fried, stays crispy throughout, served with rice, beans, guac, and sour cream
Aromatic and incredibly flavorful, a must-try breakfast dish
